criteria_text.1: golden-bug verdict FAIL; golden-clean verdict PASS.
criteria_text.2: mutants: caught = verdict FAIL; observable = observable flag true; criterion >= 70% of observable mutants caught; unobservable mutants must never be PASS when they have unexercised executable changed lines (report any violation).
criteria_text.3: paperless bug: a real verdict (any verdict whose cause is not an environment/provider/error cause); caught = FAIL AND confirmed - reported, not required.
criteria_text.4: false alarms: a FAIL verdict on a clean unit; 0 on golden-clean, <= 1 across the 3 paperless clean units. INCONCLUSIVE on clean units is reported as its own count (not an alarm in this PoC).
criteria_text.5: cost: every unit <= 10,000 AI tokens; any provider rate-limit/transport failure is reported.
